data.description: Located in Dubailand, DLRC offers a mix of residential and commercial developments.

data.answer: The sub-community in Dubailand is a thoughtfully planned community combining residential and commercial projects with ample open spaces and essential facilities. Its master plan features parks, mosques, schools, medical centers, shopping plazas, and recreational amenities, making it a well-rounded destination for families and professionals. As a profitable freehold area, it is attracting private developers to invest in new projects, further enhancing its appeal as one of the best communities for modern living in Dubai.

The DubaiLand Residence Complex real estate market offers a diverse range of options, catering to both renters and buyers. Properties available for sale include residential buildings, mixed-use plots, and apartments such as studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units. This variety makes it appealing for individuals and families seeking modern housing within a well-connected and evolving neighborhood.

Popular Buildings in DubaiLand Residence Complex

Here are some of the most popular buildings offering quality living options with modern units and amenities:

  • Etlata Residence: Offers modern layouts with studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, as well as amenities such as a swimming pool, gym, and children’s play area.
  • Samana Avenue: Features spacious units, including studios and 2-bedroom apartments, complemented by landscaped gardens, fitness facilities, and a rooftop pool.

Off-Plan Projects in DubaiLand Residence Complex

Explore exceptional off-plan projects in DubaiLand Residence Complex, where modern design meets a vibrant community lifestyle. Secure your dream home with flexible payment plans and promising investment potential.

  • Verdes by Haven: This is a premium residential development by Aldar Properties, renowned for its commitment to reliability and innovation in the UAE. Designed with a focus on health and comfort, the complex features luxury 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments in natural-toned finishes with dark and light options. 
  • Terra Tower: Terra Tower by Dugasta is an impressive 12-storey residential complex offering modern living in a prime location. Spanning two basements, a ground floor, 12 residential levels, the development is equipped with an array of lifestyle amenities that cater to every need. 

Renting a Property in DubaiLand Residence Complex

DubaiLand Residence Complex rent options provide a range of affordable and modern apartments, catering to those looking for well-designed living spaces. Tenants can choose from studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom units, all in a prime location with easy access to major highways and essential amenities. The variety of rental properties makes it a popular choice for families and professionals alike.

Buying a Property in DubaiLand Residence Complex

For those considering investing in Dubai’s real estate, Dubai Residence Complex presents an excellent opportunity, with property prices starting from around AED 770k and reaching up to AED 1.75M. This diverse price range caters to various budgets, offering modern apartments in a thriving and strategically located community.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in the DubaiLand Residence Complex?

data.answer:
Living in this neighborhood offers a modern lifestyle with well-planned residential options, excellent connectivity, and access to a range of family-friendly amenities.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in DubaiLand Residence Complex

Parking in DubaiLand Residence Complex apartments is conveniently arranged across ground floors and basement levels, ensuring ample space for residents. Visitors can also benefit from several open parking areas strategically located throughout the development, making them accessible.

Public transport options in DubaiLand Residence Complex include several bus stops near Skycourts Tower, serviced by RTA Bus 30. This route connects the neighborhood to key areas, such as the Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall Metro Station. Additionally, taxi services provide a reliable alternative for commuters.

Supermarkets in and Around DubaiLand Residence Complex

The DubaiLand Residence Complex lifestyle ensures convenience, with several supermarkets available to cater to residents’ daily needs. Key options include Shua Al Madina Supermarket in the Durar 1 building, West Zone Fresh Supermarket in Desert Sun Tower, KeyPee Market in Abidos Hotel Apartments, and EMC Mini Mart in Solitaire Cascades. These facilities make grocery shopping quick and accessible, adding to the comfort of living in this vibrant community.

Shopping Mall Near DubaiLand Residence Complex

The nearest mall is the Dubai Outlet Mall, which is just 15 minutes away and houses over 200 retail outlets, making it a favorite for discount shopping in Dubai. Alongside an array of dining options in its food court, it features Chuck E. Cheese’s, a family-friendly entertainment center with a bowling alley, ice rink, and numerous games and rides.

Schools and Nurseries in and Near DubaiLand Residence Complex

The neighborhood offers access to reputable educational institutions. The Aquila School, located opposite Desert Sun Tower, follows the British curriculum and emphasizes science, math, technology, engineering, and arts. Chubby Cheeks Nursery and Hazem Kindergarten are operational in the area for younger children.

Nearby communities like The Villa feature schools like GEMS FirstPoint School, while the neighboring Academic City serves as an educational hub. Institutions like Dubai English Speaking College, German International School, and Lycee Francais Georges Pompidou cater to diverse curriculums. Dubai International Academic City also offers top universities, including Zayed University and Hamdan Bin Mohammed Smart University.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near DubaiLand Residence Complex

Residents of this community have access to several places of worship. Churches nearby include City Hill Global Church, just 8 minutes away, and Casa de Oración Torre Fuerte, a 23-minute drive from Al Barsha. Hindu temples such as the Shiva Temple, Shree Krishna Haveli, and ShrinathJi Temple in Bur Dubai are about 30 minutes away, while Sikh residents can visit the Automech Gurudwara, 16 minutes away in Ras Al Khor Industrial Area.

DubaiLand Residence Complex provides convenient access to mosques, including Masjid A’aishah Umm Al-Mu’mineen in The Villa, Al Wasl Mosque in Liwan, and Al Waha Masjid in Dubai Silicon Oasis.

Clinics and Hospitals in and Near DubaiLand Residence Complex

Ace Medical Centres, a branch of Medicentres Polyclinics, is located in Skycourts Tower, while Dubai London Clinic is located in The Villa community.

For hospitals, Mediclinic Parkview Hospital on Umm Suqeim Street is 20 minutes away, offering comprehensive healthcare services and online appointments. King’s College Hospital London in Dubai Hills Estate is another top option, located 24 minutes from DubaiLand Residence Complex.

Location & Nearby Areas

This sub-community is strategically located along Dubai – Al Ain Road (E66) and Emirates Road (E611), offering seamless connectivity to key areas. To the northeast lies the expansive Dubai Silicon Oasis, a 7.2 sq. km. freehold business hub known for its high-tech ecosystem.

To the southwest, the community borders The Villa, a prominent residential project featuring Spanish-style homes. Additionally, rustic developments like Al Khawaneej and Al Warsan are situated on the outskirts, adding to the diverse character of the area.

more_info.question: Things to Do in DubaiLand Residence Complex

data.answer:
The community offers a mix of leisure and recreational activities, with access to shopping malls, parks, and fitness facilities within and near the community.

Restaurants

Living in DubaiLand Residence Complex provides residents with convenient dining options, including 800 Pizza, Four Square Cafe, and Eat & Drink Restaurants within the community. Skycourts Towers also features popular eateries like Pudumadam Indian Restaurant, Kabila, AlFatayir AlDumashqia, and Green Hills Restaurant. Nearby vibrant neighborhoods offer even more choices, just a short drive away.

Beaches Near DubaiLand Residence Complex

Jumeirah Beach is approximately a 24-minute drive from DubaiLand Residence Complex, easily accessible via the Dubai–Al Ain Road (E66).

Hotels Around DubaiLand Residence Complex

The nearest lodging, Abidos Hotel Apartments, is a 16-floor building with two basements, offering 132 spacious 1 to 3-bedroom units. It features dining options like MnM Café in the lobby, MnM Restaurant on the top floor, and MnM Lounge by the pool.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

The community features a variety of landscaped green spaces, including district, community, and neighborhood parks. District parks, the largest, will flank the central road, while community parks will be centrally located for all residents, and smaller neighborhood parks will serve residential clusters.

Fitness enthusiasts can benefit from on-site gym facilities in most developments. Additionally, the area offers several salons, including 1981 Gents Salon and Olive Gents Salon for men, and options like Fabulicious Ladies Salon, Las Meninas Salon, Lorita Beauty Centre, and Artisa Women Beauty Salon for women.

Community Events

DubaiLand Residence Complex lifestyle fosters a sense of community through local events and gatherings, offering residents opportunities to connect and socialize. Seasonal activities and cultural celebrations further enhance the vibrant community atmosphere.

Attractions and Landmarks

The neighborhood offers access to several equestrian clubs and stables for horse riding enthusiasts, including Al Hamra Equestrian LLC, Hobbies Club, Al Ruwayyah Stable Riding School, and Elite Rangers Jumping and Racing Stable.

Just 7 minutes away on Emirates Road, Al Habtoor Polo Resort features four lush polo fields and a range of recreational activities, such as archery, tennis courts, snooker, board games, and mini-golf, making it one of Dubai's top destinations for polo and leisure.

DubaiLand Residence Complex offers a growing community with modern amenities, well-planned infrastructure, and excellent connectivity to key areas, making it an ideal location for families and professionals alike.

data.content:
Dubailand, one of Dubai’s most significant and ambitious developments, spans an impressive 3 billion sq. ft. and encompasses numerous sought-after communities. Among these is the DubaiLand Residence Complex, also known as Dubai Residence Complex. 

The community is strategically located along key highways, including the Dubai–Al Ain Road (E66) and Emirates Road (E611). These routes provide seamless connectivity to vital business hubs such as Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Business Bay, as well as emerging residential areas like Arabian Ranches and Mudon.

Surrounded by notable developments like The Villa and Dubai Academic City, the neighborhood offers a mix of luxury apartments. With its growing infrastructure and prime position within Dubailand, the DubaiLand Residence Complex (DLRC) is evolving into a preferred destination for those looking to experience a modern yet community-focused lifestyle in Dubai.
